meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上个人微信通道：它把微信适配器复制进项目、装好依赖并构建；你用手机扫码登录后，微信私聊和群消息就能转给 Claude 处理。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加个人微信通道，或接入微信私聊、群聊时触发；前提是有已装微信的个人号、能扫码的手机、Node.js 20+。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信通道装上，装好我扫码登录
say.note: 复制适配器、安装依赖并构建，然后打印二维码

say.text: 微信登录过期了，清掉 auth 让我重新扫码
把刚才给我发消息的微信号接到 agent 上
say.note: 运行 wire-dm 脚本，让你选绑定的 agent 组

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw through Tencent's official iLink Bot API. It copies the adapter into the project, installs the pinned client and builds; after you scan the QR code, DMs and group messages reach the agent.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw or hook up WeChat DMs and group chats. Needs a personal WeChat account, a phone to scan the QR code, and Node.js 20+.

say_en.text: Set up the personal WeChat channel for me; I'll scan the QR code.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds, prints a QR URL

say_en.text: My WeChat session expired — clear auth and let me re-scan.
say_en.note: Deletes data/wechat/auth.json and asks for a new scan

say_en.text: Wire the WeChat account that just messaged the bot to an agent.
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts and asks which agent group to use
